# Trusted List Manager

## Overview

For Authentication: [https://trustedlist.serviceproviders.eudiw.dev/authentication](https://trustedlist.serviceproviders.eudiw.dev/authentication)

To authenticate, it is necessary to have a EUDIW and a PID (MSO Mdoc).
